_help.what_is_this: The white-label values for ONE shop. Every value marked REPLACE_ME must be changed before going live; the build refuses to publish a live site (PRODUCTION=1) while any REPLACE_ME remains. Everything the owner can change later in Admin → Settings (colours, texts, contact details) only needs a sensible starting value here — once the owner saves Settings and the shop publishes, settings.public.json takes over.
_help.site.url: The shop's public address, no trailing slash. Start with the free Cloudflare address, e.g. https://priya-sweets.pages.dev, and change it when a custom domain is added.
_help.site.apps_script_url: The Web app URL from Apps Script → Deploy (Setup Guide step 5). It ends in /exec.
_help.site.razorpay_key_id: Optional. Only if the shop uses Razorpay: the Key Id (rzp_test_... while testing, rzp_live_... when live). Leave empty otherwise. The Key SECRET never goes in this file.
_help.business: Starting values for the shop's name and contact details. phone and whatsapp are 10-digit Indian mobile numbers without +91. gstin may stay empty for unregistered shops. state must be the exact state name (it decides CGST+SGST vs IGST).
_help.branding.theme_preset: One of ROYAL_INDIGO, FRESH_GREEN, SAFFRON, ROSE, OCEAN, CHARCOAL_GOLD. The colours below should match the preset unless you choose custom colours.
_help.branding.logo: Optional. Path to the shop's logo inside the repository, e.g. client/assets/logo.svg (a placeholder logo is included there). Leave empty to show the shop name as text in the header. See docs/ASSETS_NEEDED.md for sizes.
_help.seo: Used for Google results and WhatsApp link previews.
_help.seller: Your own (the website provider's) details, shown to the owner only when the shop outgrows the free plan.
